examples.text_en: He studies electronics at the big new school.
examples.text_zh: 他在那所新建的大学校里学电子学。

examples.text_en: Modern electronics has changed the way we live.
examples.text_zh: 现代电子学改变了我们的生活方式。

examples.text_en: The room was decorated with quiet elegance.
examples.text_zh: 这个房间布置得素雅而高雅。

examples.text_en: She moved with the elegance of a trained dancer.
examples.text_zh: 她的举止带着训练有素的舞者般的优雅。

examples.text_en: He wrote a short elegy for his friend.
examples.text_zh: 他为朋友写了一首短短的哀歌。

examples.text_en: The poem reads like an elegy for the land.
examples.text_zh: 这首诗读起来像是为这片土地的哀歌。

examples.text_en: The elemental parts of water are very simple.
examples.text_zh: 水的元素组成非常简单。

examples.text_en: We must face the elemental needs of the body.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须面对身体最基本的需求。

examples.text_en: The heavy truck moved with elephantine slowness.
examples.text_zh: 那辆沉重的卡车移动得极为缓慢。

examples.text_en: He took an elephantine step over the low wall.
examples.text_zh: 他迈着笨重的一步跨过低墙。

examples.text_en: The teacher tried to elicit the answer from them.
examples.text_zh: 老师试着从他们那里引出答案。

examples.text_en: Good questions can elicit a long and open talk.
examples.text_zh: 好的问题能引出长久而坦率的交谈。

examples.text_en: The elimination of these jobs hurt the town.
examples.text_zh: 这些岗位的裁撤伤害了这个小镇。

examples.text_en: Their team lost in the first elimination round.
examples.text_zh: 他们队在第一轮淘汰赛中就输了。

examples.text_en: Only the elite could join that private club.
examples.text_zh: 只有精英才能加入那家私人俱乐部。

examples.text_en: The elite gathered in the quiet stone hall.
examples.text_zh: 精英们聚集在安静的石砌大厅里。

examples.text_en: People once thought gold could make an elixir.
examples.text_zh: 人们曾以为黄金能制成长生不老药。

examples.text_en: He looked for an elixir that would keep him young.
examples.text_zh: 他寻找一种能让他保持年轻的长寿药。

examples.text_en: The book used an ellipsis to show the long wait.
examples.text_zh: 书中用省略号来表现漫长的等待。

examples.text_en: An ellipsis can stand for words left out of a text.
examples.text_zh: 省略号可以代表文中略去的词语。

examples.text_en: The moon follows an elliptical path around Earth.
examples.text_zh: 月球绕着地球沿椭圆轨道运行。

examples.text_en: He drew an elliptical shape on the board.
examples.text_zh: 他在黑板上画了一个椭圆。

examples.text_en: A tall elm stood in front of the school.
examples.text_zh: 学校门前立着一棵高大的榆树。

examples.text_en: We walked to the elm at the end of the road.
examples.text_zh: 我们走到路尽头的那棵榆树旁。

examples.text_en: He won the prize for elocution at school.
examples.text_zh: 他在学校凭演讲口才得了奖。

examples.text_en: Her elocution was clear and easy to follow.
examples.text_zh: 她的吐字发音清楚，容易听懂。

examples.text_en: They will elongate the road to the new area.
examples.text_zh: 他们要把这条路延长到新城区。

examples.text_en: We can elongate this line with a light pull.
examples.text_zh: 我们轻轻一拉就能把这条线拉长。

examples.text_en: We looked for the book elsewhere in the house.
examples.text_zh: 我们在家里的别处找过这本书。

examples.text_en: If it is not here, please look elsewhere.
examples.text_zh: 如果不在这里，请到别处找找。

examples.text_en: Please elucidate your main point for the class.
examples.text_zh: 请向全班阐明你的主要观点。

examples.text_en: He tried to elucidate the difficult rule.
examples.text_zh: 他试着阐明这条难懂的规则。

examples.text_en: The thief managed to elude the police.
examples.text_zh: 小偷设法躲过了警察。

examples.text_en: The exact answer seemed to elude us.
examples.text_zh: 确切的答案似乎让我们无从捉摸。

examples.text_en: The answer was elusive and hard to find.
examples.text_zh: 答案难以捉摸，很难找到。

examples.text_en: He is an elusive man who is hard to know.
examples.text_zh: 他是个难以捉摸的人，让人看不透。

examples.text_en: The long illness would emaciate the poor child.
examples.text_zh: 长期的病痛会让这个可怜的孩子消瘦。

examples.text_en: Hard work can emaciate a man in a few months.
examples.text_zh: 繁重的劳动能在几个月内把人熬瘦。

examples.text_en: The dog was thin and badly emaciated.
examples.text_zh: 那只狗瘦骨嶙峋，十分虚弱。

examples.text_en: An emaciated child stood at the door.
examples.text_zh: 一个瘦弱的孩子站在门口。

examples.text_en: The emaciation of the child was clear to us.
examples.text_zh: 孩子消瘦的样子我们看得很清楚。

examples.text_en: Long illness can lead to emaciation and weakness.
examples.text_zh: 长期患病会导致身体的消瘦和虚弱。

examples.text_en: A warm light seemed to emanate from the room.
examples.text_zh: 似乎有温暖的光从那房间里散发出来。

examples.text_en: Good ideas often emanate from the young people.
examples.text_zh: 好点子常常来自年轻人。

examples.text_en: The new law will emancipate many poor workers.
examples.text_zh: 新法律将解放许多贫穷的工人。

examples.text_en: They hoped to emancipate the people from fear.
examples.text_zh: 他们希望把人们从恐惧中解放出来。

examples.text_en: The emancipation of the poor took many long years.
examples.text_zh: 穷苦人的解放经历了漫长的岁月。

examples.text_en: They talked about emancipation and equal rights.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈论了解放和平等的权利。

examples.text_en: Such rules can emasculate a strong leader.
examples.text_zh: 这样的规定会削弱一位强势的领导者。

examples.text_en: Fear may emasculate even a brave man.
examples.text_zh: 恐惧甚至会使勇敢的人变得软弱。

examples.text_en: They used spices to embalm the dead king.
examples.text_zh: 他们用香料为死去的国王做防腐处理。

examples.text_en: Ancient people would embalm their rulers with care.
examples.text_zh: 古时会精心地为统治者做防腐。

examples.text_en: The country put an embargo on all foreign trade.
examples.text_zh: 这个国家对所有对外贸易实行了禁运。

examples.text_en: They lifted the embargo after a long talk.
examples.text_zh: 经过长时间的会谈，他们解除了禁运。

examples.text_en: Please embed the picture in the middle of the page.
examples.text_zh: 请把图片嵌在页面中间。

examples.text_en: They embed small stones in the wall for style.
examples.text_zh: 为了美观，他们在墙里嵌入了小石头。

examples.text_en: She likes to embellish her stories with details.
examples.text_zh: 她喜欢用细节来润色自己的故事。

examples.text_en: Gold paint was used to embellish the frame.
examples.text_zh: 金漆被用来装饰这个画框。

examples.text_en: The gold line was a fine embellishment to the book.
examples.text_zh: 那道金线是这本书上漂亮的装饰。

examples.text_en: His story needs no embellishment to be good.
examples.text_zh: 他的故事不用润色就已经很好。

examples.text_en: He tried to embezzle money from the small company.
examples.text_zh: 他试图从这家小公司挪用公款。

examples.text_en: They will embezzle the public money and run.
examples.text_zh: 他们会侵吞公款然后逃跑。

examples.text_en: The embezzlement of public money was soon found.
examples.text_zh: 挪用公款的事很快就被发现了。

examples.text_en: He lost his job over embezzlement last year.
examples.text_zh: 他因挪用公款在去年丢了工作。

examples.text_en: Long delays may embitter the waiting crowd.
examples.text_zh: 长时间的延误会让等候的人群心生怨恨。

examples.text_en: The loss did not embitter the young player.
examples.text_zh: 这场失利并没有让这名年轻球员心生怨恨。

examples.text_en: They will emblazon his name on the great wall.
examples.text_zh: 他们会把他的名字装饰在那面大墙上。

examples.text_en: The story will emblazon her in the hearts of all.
examples.text_zh: 这个故事会让她被所有人铭记于心。

examples.text_en: The white dove is emblematic of peace.
examples.text_zh: 白鸽是和平的象征。

examples.text_en: That picture became emblematic of the long war.
examples.text_zh: 那张照片成了这场漫长战争的象征。

examples.text_en: She was the embodiment of grace and good sense.
examples.text_zh: 她是优雅与明智的化身。

examples.text_en: The building was an embodiment of the new idea.
examples.text_zh: 这座建筑是那个新理念的化身。

examples.text_en: These rules embody the best ideas of the group.
examples.text_zh: 这些规则体现了这个团体最好的想法。

examples.text_en: He tried to embody his dream in a real house.
examples.text_zh: 他设法把自己的梦想变成一所真实的房子。

examples.text_en: The good news would embolden the young team.
examples.text_zh: 这个好消息让年轻的团队更有胆量。

examples.text_en: Her kind words embolden him to try again.
examples.text_zh: 她温和的话语让他有勇气再试一次。

examples.text_en: Green hills embosom the small quiet village.
examples.text_zh: 绿色的山丘环抱着这座宁静的小村庄。

examples.text_en: She would embosom the child in her warm arms.
examples.text_zh: 她会把孩子抱在温暖的怀里。

examples.text_en: They emboss the gold card with a small name.
examples.text_zh: 他们在这张金卡上压印了一个小名字。

examples.text_en: The top of the box was embossed with a star.
examples.text_zh: 盒子上压印着一颗星星。

examples.text_en: She will embroider the gift with a fine line.
examples.text_zh: 她会在礼物上绣一道细致的线。

examples.text_en: He likes to embroider the truth with fine words.
examples.text_zh: 他喜欢用漂亮的言辞给事实添枝加叶。

examples.text_en: Her dress was covered with fine embroidery.
examples.text_zh: 她的裙子上绣满了精美的刺绣。

examples.text_en: She learned embroidery from her mother.
examples.text_zh: 她跟着母亲学会了刺绣。

examples.text_en: He did not want to embroil us in the dispute.
examples.text_zh: 他不想把我们卷进这场纠纷。

examples.text_en: Such a choice may embroil the firm in trouble.
examples.text_zh: 这样的选择可能会让公司陷入麻烦。

examples.text_en: The embryo was still in its first days of life.
examples.text_zh: 胚胎还处在最初几天的发育阶段。

examples.text_en: They studied the embryo under a strong light.
examples.text_zh: 他们在强光下研究这个胚胎。

examples.text_en: The paper describes an embryological study of frogs.
examples.text_zh: 这篇论文描述了一项关于青蛙的胚胎学研究。

examples.text_en: They examined the embryological development of the fish.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究了这种鱼的胚胎发育过程。

examples.text_en: The plan is still in its embryonic stage.
examples.text_zh: 这个计划仍处在萌芽阶段。

examples.text_en: Their new idea was only embryonic at that time.
examples.text_zh: 那时他们的新想法还不成熟。

examples.text_en: The editor will emend the text before printing.
examples.text_zh: 编辑会在付印前修订文本。

examples.text_en: He had to emend several lines of the poem.
examples.text_zh: 他不得不修改这首诗的几行。

examples.text_en: She wore a small emerald on her left hand.
examples.text_zh: 她左手上戴着一颗小小的绿宝石。

examples.text_en: The sea was a deep emerald green today.
examples.text_zh: 今天的大海是深翠绿色的。

examples.text_en: We must be ready for emergencies at any time.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须随时准备好应对紧急事件。

examples.text_en: The team can deal with emergencies very well.
examples.text_zh: 这个团队能很好地处理紧急事件。

examples.text_en: They plan to emigrate to a new country soon.
examples.text_zh: 他们打算不久后移居到一个新的国家。

examples.text_en: Many young people emigrate to find better work.
examples.text_zh: 许多年轻人移居他乡以寻找更好的工作。

examples.text_en: The doctor gained eminence through his careful work.
examples.text_zh: 这位医生凭细致的钻研赢得了声望。

examples.text_en: They watched the storm from a rocky eminence.
examples.text_zh: 他们从一处岩石高地上观看暴风雨。

examples.text_en: The eminent doctor came to help the poor child.
examples.text_zh: 这位杰出的医生来帮助那个可怜的孩子。

examples.text_en: She is an eminent writer in our country.
examples.text_zh: 她是我们国家一位杰出的作家。

examples.text_en: The king sent an emissary to the small town.
examples.text_zh: 国王派了一名使者前往那个小镇。

examples.text_en: A quiet emissary carried the secret letter.
examples.text_zh: 一名沉默的使者带着密信。

examples.text_en: These lamps emit a warm, soft light.
examples.text_zh: 这些灯发出温暖柔和的光。

examples.text_en: The engine began to emit a strange noise.
examples.text_zh: 发动机开始发出奇怪的噪音。

examples.text_en: This oil has an emollient effect on the skin.
examples.text_zh: 这种油对皮肤有柔润的作用。

examples.text_en: She used an emollient cream for her hands.
examples.text_zh: 她往手上抹了一种柔润的护肤霜。

examples.text_en: His emolument was small for so much work.
examples.text_zh: 做了这么多工作，他的报酬却很少。

examples.text_en: They asked for a better emolument and less work.
examples.text_zh: 他们要求更高的薪水和更少的工作。

examples.text_en: The young man likes to emote on the stage.
examples.text_zh: 这个年轻人在舞台上喜欢夸张地表现感情。

examples.text_en: She would emote over every small thing in life.
examples.text_zh: 生活中每件小事她都要大动感情。

examples.text_en: She felt real empathy for the young boy.
examples.text_zh: 她对那个小男孩怀有真切的共鸣。

examples.text_en: Good teachers show empathy for their students.
examples.text_zh: 好老师会对学生表现出共情。

examples.text_en: Her answer was a short, emphatic no.
examples.text_zh: 她的回答是一个简短而坚决的不字。

examples.text_en: He gave an emphatic nod to show agreement.
examples.text_zh: 他重重地点了点头表示同意。

examples.text_en: The study is based on empirical work in the field.
examples.text_zh: 这项研究以该领域的实证工作为基础。

examples.text_en: We need empirical facts, not fine words.
examples.text_zh: 我们需要的是实证事实，而不是漂亮的言辞。

examples.text_en: His empiricism made him trust only what he saw.
examples.text_zh: 他的经验主义使他只相信自己亲眼所见。

examples.text_en: They talked about empiricism in the science class.
examples.text_zh: 他们在科学课上讨论了经验主义。

examples.text_en: The new law will empower local school boards.
examples.text_zh: 新法律将赋予地方学校董事会权力。

examples.text_en: Good teachers empower their students to think.
examples.text_zh: 好老师能让学生学会独立思考。

examples.text_en: They sang of an empyreal home above the clouds.
examples.text_zh: 他们歌唱云端之上的天堂。

examples.text_en: A soft, empyreal light filled the quiet church.
examples.text_zh: 一种柔和而神圣的光充满了安静的教堂。

examples.text_en: The birds seemed to reach the empyrean at last.
examples.text_zh: 鸟儿似乎终于飞到了九天之上。

examples.text_en: He looked up at the empyrean and felt small.
examples.text_zh: 他仰望苍天，感到自己十分渺小。

examples.text_en: Young players try to emulate their favorite star.
examples.text_zh: 年轻球员努力效仿他们喜爱的明星。

examples.text_en: She hoped her son would emulate his father.
examples.text_zh: 她希望儿子能效法他的父亲。

examples.text_en: Beat the eggs to emulsify the oil.
examples.text_zh: 搅打鸡蛋，使油乳化。

examples.text_en: This machine can emulsify the mixture in seconds.
examples.text_zh: 这台机器能在几秒钟内把混合物乳化。

examples.text_en: The city will enact a new parking rule.
examples.text_zh: 该市将颁布一项新的停车规定。

examples.text_en: They plan to enact the story on the stage.
examples.text_zh: 他们打算把这个故事搬上舞台演出。

examples.text_en: The enactment of the new law took many months.
examples.text_zh: 新法律的制定花了好几个月。

examples.text_en: They talked about the enactment of fair rules.
examples.text_zh: 他们讨论了公正规则的制定。

examples.text_en: The bright enamel on the cup had chipped.
examples.text_zh: 杯子上的亮釉已经磕掉了一块。

examples.text_en: She wore a small enamel pin on her coat.
examples.text_zh: 她在外套上别了一枚小小的珐琅别针。

examples.text_en: These lines encapsulate the main idea of the book.
examples.text_zh: 这几行概括了这本书的中心思想。

examples.text_en: The pill can encapsulate the bitter medicine.
examples.text_zh: 这种药丸能把苦味的药封装起来。

examples.text_en: Thick ice began to encase the small branches.
examples.text_zh: 厚厚的冰开始包住细小的树枝。

examples.text_en: They will encase the wires in a soft cover.
examples.text_zh: 他们会把电线包在柔软的护套里。

examples.text_en: They encipher the note before sending it out.
examples.text_zh: 他们在送出之前把便条译成密码。

examples.text_en: Please encipher this short line for the team.
examples.text_zh: 请为团队把这句短语译成密码。

examples.text_en: The letter had a small enclosure inside.
examples.text_zh: 信里附了一份小附件。

examples.text_en: The animals lived in a wide grassy enclosure.
examples.text_zh: 这些动物生活在一片宽阔的草地上。

examples.text_en: The encomiast praised the mayor in every speech.
examples.text_zh: 这位颂扬者在每次演讲中都赞美市长。

examples.text_en: A true encomiast finds good in almost everything.
examples.text_zh: 真正的赞美者几乎能在任何事物中发现优点。

examples.text_en: He wrote a warm encomium for his teacher.
examples.text_zh: 他为老师写了一篇热情的赞辞。

examples.text_en: The speech was a long encomium to the hero.
examples.text_zh: 这篇演讲是对那位英雄的长篇颂词。

examples.text_en: Their plans encompass many small, useful changes.
examples.text_zh: 他们的计划包含许多小而实用的变动。

examples.text_en: Tall walls encompass the quiet garden and house.
examples.text_zh: 高墙围绕着安静的花园和房屋。

examples.text_en: Your encouragement gave me the power to go on.
examples.text_zh: 你的鼓励给了我继续下去的力量。

examples.text_en: She needs a little encouragement from her friends.
examples.text_zh: 她需要朋友们给她一点鼓励。

examples.text_en: The sea will encroach on the land each year.
examples.text_zh: 海水每年都会侵蚀这片土地。

examples.text_en: They did not want to encroach on his free time.
examples.text_zh: 他们不想侵占他的空闲时间。

examples.text_en: Heavy bags can encumber a tired walker.
examples.text_zh: 沉重的包会拖累疲惫的步行者。

examples.text_en: Strict rules may encumber the new company.
examples.text_zh: 严格的规定可能会拖累这家新公司。

examples.text_en: Throwing waste there could endanger the fish.
examples.text_zh: 往那儿扔垃圾会危及鱼类。

examples.text_en: Careless drivers endanger the lives of others.
examples.text_zh: 粗心的司机危及他人的生命。

examples.text_en: Her endearing smile made everyone feel welcome.
examples.text_zh: 她可爱的笑容让每个人都感到亲切。

examples.text_en: He has an endearing way of talking to children.
examples.text_zh: 他跟孩子说话的方式很讨人喜欢。

examples.text_en: The endemic was common in that warm area.
examples.text_zh: 这种地方病在那个温暖地区很常见。

examples.text_en: They studied the endemic for many long years.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究这种地方病研究了许多年。

examples.text_en: The group will endorse the new plan today.
examples.text_zh: 这个团体今天将支持这项新计划。

examples.text_en: Many people endorse her idea of free education.
examples.text_zh: 许多人赞同她关于免费教育的主张。

examples.text_en: An endotherm can keep warm in the cold sea.
examples.text_zh: 热血动物能在冰冷的海水里保持体温。

examples.text_en: The endotherm needs much food to stay warm.
examples.text_zh: 热血动物需要大量食物来维持体温。

examples.text_en: The test found a small amount of endotoxin.
examples.text_zh: 检测发现存在少量内毒素。

examples.text_en: Bacteria release endotoxin when their walls break.
examples.text_zh: 细菌在壁破裂时会释放内毒素。

examples.text_en: The school got a large endowment from her.
examples.text_zh: 学校从她那里得到了一大笔捐助。

examples.text_en: He has a real endowment for music and art.
examples.text_zh: 他在音乐和艺术上很有天赋。

examples.text_en: They believe nature will endue her with strength.
examples.text_zh: 他们相信大自然会赋予她力量。

examples.text_en: The king chose to endue him with a title.
examples.text_zh: 国王决定授予他一个称号。

examples.text_en: The long race tests the endurance of every player.
examples.text_zh: 漫长的比赛考验着每位选手的耐力。

examples.text_en: She showed great endurance through all those years.
examples.text_zh: 在那些岁月里，她表现出极大的忍耐力。

examples.text_en: Their enduring friendship has lasted forty years.
examples.text_zh: 他们持久的友谊已经延续了四十年。

examples.text_en: She found enduring joy in simple daily work.
examples.text_zh: 她在简单的日常工作中找到了持久的快乐。

examples.text_en: A short walk can energize a tired mind.
examples.text_zh: 短暂散步能让疲惫的头脑恢复活力。

examples.text_en: Good music will energize the young team.
examples.text_zh: 好音乐能让这支年轻的队伍充满活力。

examples.text_en: The long hot day would enervate the workers.
examples.text_zh: 漫长炎热的一天会让工人们筋疲力尽。

examples.text_en: Bad food can enervate a man over time.
examples.text_zh: 糟糕的食物时间久了会让人变得虚弱。

examples.text_en: Long illness can enfeeble even a strong body.
examples.text_zh: 长期患病甚至会使强壮的身体变得虚弱。

examples.text_en: Hunger will enfeeble the tired workers.
examples.text_zh: 饥饿会使疲惫的工人变得衰弱。

examples.text_en: They used heavy chains to enfetter the prisoner.
examples.text_zh: 他们用沉重的锁链束缚那名囚犯。

examples.text_en: Fear can enfetter a mind and stop all growth.
examples.text_zh: 恐惧会束缚心灵，阻碍一切成长。

examples.text_en: Dry wood will enflame quickly in the wind.
examples.text_zh: 干柴在风里会很快燃烧起来。

examples.text_en: His words could enflame the angry crowd.
examples.text_zh: 他的话会煽动愤怒的人群。

examples.text_en: The police must enforce the law in every town.
examples.text_zh: 警察必须在每个城镇执行法律。

examples.text_en: They will enforce the new rules from next week.
examples.text_zh: 他们将从下周起执行新规定。

examples.text_en: Such news can engender fear among the people.
examples.text_zh: 这样的消息会在人们中间引起恐慌。

examples.text_en: Kind acts often engender trust and warm friendship.
examples.text_zh: 善举往往能带来信任和温暖的友谊。

examples.text_en: The book has a fine engraving on its cover.
examples.text_zh: 这本书的封面上有一幅精美的雕版画。

examples.text_en: He studied the fine engraving on the metal plate.
examples.text_zh: 他端详着金属板上精美的雕刻。

examples.text_en: His complete engrossment in the task surprised us.
examples.text_zh: 他做这件事时全神贯注，让我们很吃惊。

examples.text_en: She showed deep engrossment in her quiet reading.
examples.text_zh: 她安静地读书，显得非常专注。

examples.text_en: Flames began to engulf the empty wooden house.
examples.text_zh: 火焰开始吞没那座空木屋。

examples.text_en: Dark clouds would engulf the small mountain town.
examples.text_zh: 乌云会吞没这座小山镇。

examples.text_en: A few lights enhance the quiet evening mood.
examples.text_zh: 几盏灯增添了夜晚安静的气氛。

examples.text_en: Spices enhance the taste of a simple soup.
examples.text_zh: 香料能提升清汤的味道。
